questions.question: One attention layer extracts features but cannot carry language alone. What turns layers into a model?
options: A single wider layer only
Fewer layers with no plumbing
Attention without any stacking
Depth with the six stackable design decisions
questions.explanation: Capacity needs stackable depth. This lesson packages the transformer skeleton every model inherits.

questions.question: What sequence of sublayers does decoder_block apply after its first RMSNorm?
options: Bidirectional self-attention, pooling, then a classifier with no residuals
Causal self-attention, encoder cross-attention, then an FFN, each with a residual
Only cross-attention to enc_out, followed by a second tokenizer
An FFN, then causal self-attention, while ignoring enc_out
questions.explanation: decoder_block first adds masked self-attention, then attends to enc_out, and finally adds the selected FFN output.

questions.question: How does rms_norm differ from layer_norm in this implementation?
options: RMSNorm normalizes across sequence positions, while LayerNorm uses one token
RMSNorm subtracts the mean twice and never computes a square
RMSNorm divides by root mean square without subtracting the row mean
They are identical except for the function name
questions.explanation: rms_norm computes sqrt(mean(v²)+eps) and divides; layer_norm also computes and subtracts the row mean.

questions.question: What operation defines ffn_swiglu(X, W1, W2, W3)?
options: A residual addition of W1, W2, and W3 without matrix products
W1 applied after a softmax over tokens, followed by W2+W3
A ReLU on XW2 with W1 and W3 used only for scaling the loss
W2 applied to silu(XW1) elementwise multiplied by XW3
questions.explanation: The code forms h1=XW1 and h3=XW3, gates silu(h1) by h3, then projects the result with W2.

questions.question: What does causal=True change inside scaled_dot_product_attention?
options: It masks score entries where j>i before softmax
It removes the sqrt(dk) scale from every score
It reverses K and V so the decoder reads the encoder backward
It replaces softmax with an argmax over the future
questions.explanation: The mask marks future columns j>i as -inf, so their post-softmax weights become zero.

questions.question: Why does decoder_block pass enc_out as kv_source for its cross-attention?
options: It lets the decoder reuse the source vocabulary without computing attention
Queries come from the decoder state while keys and values come from the encoded source sequence
It makes the decoder causal mask apply to source positions instead of target positions
It replaces the target residual stream with a copy of enc_out
questions.explanation: multi_head_attention always forms Q from X but uses kv_source for K and V, which is the encoder-decoder attention pattern.
